note: Commands Claude pushes for the Studio plugin to run. Each runs once, identified by id. The plugin prints every command before running it, and only runs them at all while 'Allow commands' is switched on.

commands.label: Say hello and report what is in this place
commands.luau:
-- First command across the bridge. Reads only; changes nothing.
return function()
	local sss = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
	local rs  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local sp  = game:GetService("StarterPlayer")
	local function count(root)
		if not root then return 0 end
		local n = 0
		for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then n = n + 1 end
		end
		return n
	end
	local server = sss:FindFirstChild("Server")
	local shared = rs:FindFirstChild("Shared")
	local sps    = sp:FindFirstChild("StarterPlayerScripts")
	local client = sps and sps:FindFirstChild("Client")
	local parts = 0
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then parts = parts + 1 end
	end
	print("=======================================")
	print("  Claude is connected to this place.")
	print("  Server scripts : " .. count(server))
	print("  Shared scripts : " .. count(shared))
	print("  Client scripts : " .. count(client))
	print("  Parts in Workspace: " .. parts)
	print("  Nothing was changed by this command.")
	print("=======================================")
	return true
end

commands.label: Delete the leaderboard board, the shop building, the upgrade pads, the path lamps and every light
commands.luau:
-- These were all deleted from the code some time ago. A place with a BAKED
-- map keeps its own copy, and the server never rebuilds over it, so they stay
-- standing no matter how many times the code is synced. This removes them from
-- the place itself.
--
-- It deletes by exact name, from a fixed list, and nothing else. Everything it
-- removes is listed in the Output first, and the whole thing is ONE Ctrl+Z.
return function()
	local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

	local NAMES = {
		-- the leaderboard board that stood at spawn
		LBBase = "leaderboard board", LBBack = "leaderboard board",
		LBFrame = "leaderboard board", LBTitle = "leaderboard board",
		-- the shop building, west of spawn next to the rebirth machine
		ShopFloor = "shop building", ShopWallF = "shop building",
		ShopWallB = "shop building", ShopWallL = "shop building",
		ShopWallR = "shop building", ShopRoof = "shop building",
		ShopRoofNeon = "shop building", ShopSign = "shop building",
		-- the lamp posts that lined the walking paths
		LampPost = "path lamp", LampArm = "path lamp", LampHead = "path lamp",
	}
	local PREFIXES = { UpgPad_ = "upgrade pad", UpgIcon_ = "upgrade pad" }

	local function labelFor(name)
		if NAMES[name] then return NAMES[name] end
		for prefix, label in pairs(PREFIXES) do
			if string.sub(name, 1, #prefix) == prefix then return label end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local doomed, lights, counts = {}, {}, {}
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		local label = labelFor(d.Name)
		if label then
			table.insert(doomed, d)
			counts[label] = (counts[label] or 0) + 1
		elseif d:IsA("PointLight") or d:IsA("SpotLight") or d:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
			-- "the glow". The current map has no light sources at all.
			table.insert(lights, d)
		end
	end

	print("=======================================")
	if #doomed == 0 and #lights == 0 then
		print("  Nothing to remove - this place is already clean.")
		print("  If you can still SEE the shop or the board, they are")
		print("  named something else. Press Snapshot and send it over.")
		print("=======================================")
		return true
	end
	for label, n in pairs(counts) do
		print(string.format("  %-16s %d part(s)", label, n))
	end
	if #lights > 0 then
		print(string.format("  %-16s %d", "light sources", #lights))
	end

	local rec
	pcall(function()
		rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("Remove the old build")
	end)

	for _, d in ipairs(doomed) do
		pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
	end
	for _, l in ipairs(lights) do
		pcall(function() l:Destroy() end)
	end

	if rec then
		pcall(function()
			ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec,
				Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit)
		end)
	end

	print(string.format("  Removed %d part(s) and %d light(s).",
		#doomed, #lights))
	print("  Ctrl+Z puts it all back. Ctrl+S keeps it.")
	print("=======================================")
	return true
end

commands.label: Find every glowing part outside the volcano and turn the glow off
commands.luau:
-- Strip the glow out of a baked map.
--
-- The current code builds the map with ZERO light sources and exactly 13 neon
-- parts, all of them lava, the volcano crater and the space station's window
-- band -- everything past x=300. A place with a BAKED map keeps its own older
-- copy, which the server never rebuilds over, so an old glowing rebirth pad
-- stays standing no matter how many times the code is synced.
--
-- This changes MATERIAL and deletes lights. It never deletes a part, so
-- nothing can be lost, and the whole thing is one Ctrl+Z.
return function()
	local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
	local LEGIT_FROM_X = 300   -- volcano and space live past here

	local neon, lights, particles = {}, {}, {}
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			if d.Material == Enum.Material.Neon and d.Position.X < LEGIT_FROM_X then
				table.insert(neon, d)
			end
		elseif d:IsA("PointLight") or d:IsA("SpotLight") or d:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
			table.insert(lights, d)
		elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			table.insert(particles, d)
		end
	end

	print("=======================================")
	print("  GLOW IN THIS PLACE")
	print(string.format("  neon parts outside the volcano/space: %d", #neon))
	-- Every number floored before %d sees it. A part 0.3 studs high is
	-- normal (the rebirth ring is one) and string.format('%d', 0.3)
	-- raises 'number has no integer representation' — the command would
	-- have died half way through, after printing the header.
	for i = 1, math.min(#neon, 20) do
		local p = neon[i]
		print(string.format("     %-22s at (%d, %d, %d)  size %dx%dx%d",
			p.Name,
			math.floor(p.Position.X), math.floor(p.Position.Y), math.floor(p.Position.Z),
			math.floor(p.Size.X), math.floor(p.Size.Y), math.floor(p.Size.Z)))
	end
	if #neon > 20 then print(string.format("     ... and %d more", #neon - 20)) end
	print(string.format("  light sources: %d", #lights))
	print(string.format("  particle emitters: %d (left alone, only listed)", #particles))

	if #neon == 0 and #lights == 0 then
		print("  Nothing to change - this place has no stray glow.")
		print("=======================================")
		return true
	end

	local rec
	pcall(function()
		rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("Strip the glow")
	end)
	for _, p in ipairs(neon) do
		pcall(function() p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic end)
	end
	for _, l in ipairs(lights) do
		pcall(function() l:Destroy() end)
	end
	if rec then
		pcall(function()
			ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec,
				Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit)
		end)
	end

	print(string.format("  Changed %d part(s) to SmoothPlastic, removed %d light(s).",
		#neon, #lights))
	print("  Ctrl+Z puts it back. Ctrl+S keeps it.")
	print("=======================================")
	return true
end
